description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `interpolated-part` is refused by point 3 (`staticness`) for a part bound in the sources, and here it is pinned to the words the same point says of the package's side (`part-bound-in-a-block-in-package` holds them) — the drift a pinned message exists to catch — and then to the shapes the runner refuses before it compares anything: no fragment, a number the refusal would carry were it read as text (`1 in the sources`), and a blank fragment, which every refusal carries. The runner has to report each, and nothing of the case pinned to its own `message`.
